digest.component_or_area: Jira Data Center backend + reconciler configuration
propositions: JiraDataCenterBackend does not implement query_project and assert_env_ready required by the Backend protocol, causing isinstance checks to fail and inbound fetches to raise AttributeError
reconciler.backend configuration validator rejects 'jira-datacenter' despite the backend being registered in the adapter registry, making the backend unreachable from config

DC inbound identity minting fails silently because the accountId guard returns early and the creation_channel 'jira-datacenter' is not in CREATION_CHANNELS, but fixing the guard alone creates a swallowed ValueError

a writing reconcile pass against real Jira DC crashes with 'set_entity_property' not found on JiraDataCenterTransport because the method is called by core code but never declared in the TicketTransport Protocol
test_backend_contract.py fixture does not include jira-datacenter so the DC backend has never been validated against the generic backend port contract assertions
